newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends lower on NY-led liquidation.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends lower on NY-led liquidation.

text.p: White sugar futures ended weaker but off lows on Monday after speculative liquidation in New York extended to the European market, traders said.
"London is following New York. There has been stop loss selling all the way down," a trader said.
The selling sent May sugar spiralling to a low of $305.00 per tonne before prices bounced to finish at $307.10, a decline of $1.90 from Friday.
August sugar was last at $306.00, down $2.10, while overall volume was 1,561 lots.
Earlier in the day May had dominated London activity, hitting initial resistance at $310.00 but then backing off to hover around its $309.10 open level before diving in late trading.
At 1830 GMT New York's spot May contract was weaker but off its lows at 10.83 cents, down 0.14.
